rules.pass: The API says the relay is synced.
rules.warn: The relay is not synced and has not been in sync since it started, or it is 53 blocks or fewer behind.
rules.fail: The relay had been in sync since its last start and is now more than 53 blocks behind.
rules.unknown: The API or the log could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.synced: The relay is synced at height {height}.
advice.first-sync: The relay has not finished its first sync since it started, and is {blocks} blocks behind at height {height}. Wait for it to catch up. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/network/.
advice.fell-behind: The relay was in sync and is now {blocks} blocks behind at height {height}. Check its peers and its log. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/network/.
advice.catching-up: The relay is {blocks} blocks behind at height {height}, and catching up. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/network/.

rules.pass: The log shows no fork recovery, download failure or corruption line in the window.
rules.warn: The log shows 1 or 2 fork recoveries, a download failure, or a corruption line while the relay still runs.
rules.fail: The log shows 3 or more fork recoveries in the window, or a corruption line and the relay is stopped.
rules.unknown: The relay's log could not be read, or its level hides info lines.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.none: The log shows no fork recovery in the last {minutes} minutes.
advice.some: The log shows {forks} fork recoveries and {failures} failed downloads in the last {minutes} minutes. A few are normal. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#sync-forks.
advice.many: The log shows {forks} fork recoveries in the last {minutes} minutes. Check the relay's peers and its clock. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#sync-forks.
advice.corruption-logged: The log shows a line about corrupted state, and the relay still runs. Do not delete any data. Read https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#sync-forks before you act.
advice.corrupted: The relay stopped after logging that its state is corrupted. Do not delete any data. Read https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#sync-forks before you act.
